release.content: pubrel 0.4.0 was released on 2026-10-05 from commit 3997cb69934e77f31527329032ba91af9257696a with these changes.

rows: Versions follow Cargo's convention below 1.0.0: changed or removed bumps the minor version (0.3.1 to 0.4.0), and added, fixed or security bumps the patch version. From 1.0.0 the rules are as before. Versions are semver::Version, parsed strictly (no pre-release or build suffix), and the pub this drives must satisfy ^0.1 as Cargo reads it (at least 0.1.0, below 0.2.0).
